assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire records hours spent on paid employment (Question 29: "¿Cuántas horas en promedio trabaja al día en su ocupación?"), but does not ask respondents how they allocate or spend their time across daily activities (such as unpaid care, domestic work, education, or leisure). Unpaid care and domestic tasks are mentioned only as reasons for not seeking work (Question 6, option 11) or as categories of inactivity / status (Question 7, option 2).
